name: MotionBench
intro: MotionBench 是细粒度视频运动理解基准，通过复杂交互、特定领域和 Unity 合成三条独立流程构建 5,385 个视频与 8,052 道选择题；官方固定数据实际划分为 4,018 道开发集与 4,034 道测试集，另独立发布 5,000 个视频的动态字幕数据。
build_method: 公开视频与既有数据集收集, Unity 渲染, GPT-4o 自动构题, 人工标注与复核
metric: Accuracy, Answered Accuracy, MR, LM, CM, MO, AO, RC
eval_feature: 三路并行构建, 首帧三模型门槛, 数据实际划分, 论文与实现评分边界
build_method_en: Public-video and Existing-dataset Collection, Unity Rendering, GPT-4o QA Generation, Human Annotation and Review
eval_feature_en: Three Parallel Build Streams, Three-model First-frame Gate, Data-backed Split, Paper-versus-implementation Scoring Boundaries
intro_en: MotionBench is a fine-grained video-motion-understanding benchmark built through three independent intricate-interaction, specific-field, and Unity-synthetic streams into 5,385 videos and 8,052 multiple-choice QAs; the fixed official data has 4,018 DEV and 4,034 TEST QAs and separately releases 5,000 dynamically captioned videos.
